corrections.subject: 00424a10
corrections.was: CG_array_ctor_helper_00424a10 (the ledger tagged it a compiler-generated array-constructor helper)
corrections.is: the constructor of the gameplay tuning settings object: __thiscall, writes the vtable 00CE3994 at 00424A34, sets the defaults at 00424A3E-00424BEF and tail-calls the Lua loader 0083B5E0 at 00424BFC with ECX still holding the object
corrections.evidence: 00424CB6 calls it with ECX = the 76Ch block from operator_new at 00424C9F; 00424A34 MOV dword ptr [ESI],0x00CE3994; 00424BF5 MOV ECX,ESI then 00424BFC CALL 0x0083B5E0; 00424C06 MOV EAX,ESI returns this

corrections.subject: settings+80h..+15Fh
corrections.was: docs/GAME_TUNING_SINGLETON.md and docs/VEHICLE_CLASS_LUA_LOAD.md: what fills settings+80h..+F0h is unknown; the candidate is the 6412-instruction 0083B5E0
corrections.is: 0083B5E0 does fill it, at 00841B7B-008425A1: two 70h-byte int records, AvoidZoneDepthsSingle at +80h and AvoidZoneDepthsMulti at +F0h, indexed by ship class key with two slots per class and five for MiniSub and Submarine
corrections.evidence: 00841B7B XOR EBP,EBP then the pass select at 00841B7F: 00841B81 LEA EDI,[ESI+80h] with key 00D0A228 'AvoidZoneDepthsSingle', 00841B8E LEA EDI,[ESI+F0h] with key 00D0A210 'AvoidZoneDepthsMulti'; 28 stores 00841BEE-008425A1 of the form MOV dword ptr [EDI + disp],EAX after 00B66290 GetInteger; disp spans 00h..6Ch, so each record is 70h wide and +80h + 70h = +F0h

corrections.subject: settings+3C8h and +3CCh
corrections.was: docs/UNIT_FIRE_AND_REPAIR.md: +3C8h is the fire damage divisor and +3CCh the water damage divisor, values contract: unread
corrections.is: the roles stand and the values are 3 and 3, but the authored Lua key names are crossed relative to them: +3C8h is PumpRepairMultiplier and +3CCh is FireRepairMultiplier, while their consumers are 0093C120 (fire) and 0093C210 (water). Both ship as 3, so a shipped run cannot tell the difference
corrections.evidence: 0083E3CB FSTP float ptr [ESI + 3C8h] after the key at 00D0ACF4 'PumpRepairMultiplier'; 0083E417 FSTP float ptr [ESI + 3CCh] after the key at 00D0ACDC 'FireRepairMultiplier'; shipglobals.lua lines 84 and 85 gloss them as the water and the fire damage-over-time divisors; the consumer sweep finds +3C8h read only by 0093C120 and +3CCh only by 0093C210. The two consumer bodies were not re-read here
